column1: # Kutipan perkenalan karakter (GunData f7) — 63 baris, muncul saat Doll bergabung.
# Mengikuti konvensi 20_char_bio.tsv: Commander -> "Komandan" (sebutan, bukan nama).
# Tetap Inggris: semua nama diri & organisasi (Mosin-Nagant, Suomi, Cheyanne, Nemesis,
# P90, Mityl, Koleda, Lewis, Florence, Alva, AN-94, Sakura, Ouka Kyuso, Loreley,
# Colphne, Vepley, Sharkry, Tololo, Nagant, Centaureissi, Sabrina, Belka, Zhaohui,
# Daiyan, Jiangyu, Faye, Mechty, Klukai, Peri, Robella, Lind, Elmo, H.I.D.E. 404,
# 16Lab, Caretaker), serta Doll, T-Doll, Tactical Doll, Master, Boss.
What kind of melody will be born out of my reunion with the Commander? I look forward to it.
column2: Melodi seperti apa yang akan lahir dari pertemuanku kembali dengan Komandan? Aku menantikannya.

column1: Security Doll Squad Leader, Mosin-Nagant, at your service... Huh? Aren't you... the Commander? It's been so long! Where have you been all this time?
column2: Pemimpin Regu Doll Keamanan, Mosin-Nagant, siap melayani... Lho? Bukankah kau... Komandan? Sudah lama sekali! Ke mana saja kau selama ini?

column1: Ha... ha... I finally... found you. Hurry, let me in!
column2: Hah... hah... akhirnya... kutemukan kau. Cepat, izinkan aku masuk!

column1: Commander, running into trouble? Leave it to me, I've got this!
column2: Komandan, ada masalah? Serahkan padaku, aku bisa!

column1: The employer... is the Commander? In that case... how about I give you a discount now, and we put together a long-term employment contract?
column2: Pemberi kerjanya... Komandan? Kalau begitu... bagaimana kalau kuberi diskon sekarang, lalu kita susun kontrak kerja jangka panjang?

column1: Commander, may you guide my arrows.
column2: Komandan, semoga kau menuntun anak panahku.

column1: Ah—! C-Commander, I-I'm so h-happy to see you! Is there anything I-I can help y-you with?!
column2: Ah—! K-Komandan, a-aku s-senang sekali bertemu denganmu! A-ada yang b-bisa kubantu?!

column1: So at the end of the wind and snow... it was you. Commander, I'm glad to meet you again. Suomi, reporting for duty.
column2: Jadi di ujung angin dan salju... ternyata kau. Komandan, aku senang bertemu denganmu lagi. Suomi, lapor untuk bertugas.

column1: Commander, do you still remember me? I've been chasing you all this time, but I've finally found you. This is Cheyanne, reporting to you once again.
column2: Komandan, kau masih ingat aku? Selama ini aku mengejarmu, dan akhirnya kutemukan. Ini Cheyanne, kembali melapor padamu.

column1: Darling! This game of cat and mouse is over, I finally found you!
column2: Sayang! Permainan kucing-kucingan ini selesai, akhirnya kutemukan kau!

column1: It's been a while, Commander. I've been preparing a long time in order to better help you. Going forward, I'll do my best for you, no matter how difficult things get!
column2: Sudah lama tidak bertemu, Komandan. Aku sudah lama bersiap supaya bisa lebih membantumu. Ke depan, aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin untukmu, sesulit apa pun keadaannya!

column1: Are you willing to take in an abandoned "vessel"? I fear that your kindness may end up nurturing a monster beyond your control.
column2: Kau bersedia menampung sebuah "wadah" yang terbuang? Aku khawatir kebaikanmu justru akan membesarkan monster yang tak bisa kau kendalikan.

column1: I've finally returned to your side, Commander. We have a long road ahead of us, so let's enjoy each other's presence, alright?
column2: Akhirnya aku kembali ke sisimu, Komandan. Jalan di depan kita masih panjang, jadi mari saling menikmati kehadiran satu sama lain, ya?

column1: The scattered gnosis of the past finally converges today... Commander, Nemesis has returned to the unit.
column2: Pengetahuan masa lalu yang berserak akhirnya menyatu hari ini... Komandan, Nemesis sudah kembali ke kesatuan.

column1: Uwah~ Catch me, Commander—! Hehe, still recognize me?
column2: Uwah~ Tangkap aku, Komandan—! Hehe, masih mengenaliku?

column1: By the guidance of the bluebird of happiness... P90's back! Commander, you can call me Mityl from now on~ No matter where you go, I'll fly~ back to your side!
column2: Dengan tuntunan burung biru kebahagiaan... P90 kembali! Komandan, mulai sekarang panggil aku Mityl~ Ke mana pun kau pergi, aku akan terbang~ kembali ke sisimu!

column1: Master! I'm finally back by your side~ In order to help you, I will continue to work hard to become stronger!
column2: Master! Akhirnya aku kembali ke sisimu~ Demi membantumu, aku akan terus berusaha keras jadi lebih kuat!

column1: 'Long time no see, Commander. I am Koleda. Rejoice. My arrival means spring is about to return.'
column2: 'Sudah lama tidak bertemu, Komandan. Aku Koleda. Bergembiralah. Kedatanganku berarti musim semi akan kembali.'

column1: …At last, I've met you, the person from my dreams.
column2: …Akhirnya aku bertemu denganmu, orang yang ada di mimpiku.

column1: What you see as scrap metal isn't necessarily trash to me, but treasure.
column2: Yang kau lihat sebagai rongsokan logam belum tentu sampah bagiku, tapi harta karun.

column1: Pan paka pan~ Tactical Doll and toy designer Lewis is here with her army of tin soldiers! Long time no see, Commander!
column2: Pan paka pan~ Tactical Doll sekaligus perancang mainan, Lewis, hadir bersama pasukan prajurit timahnya! Lama tidak bertemu, Komandan!

column1: Don't worry, Commander. Your most outstanding detective is now your exclusive T-Doll.
column2: Tenang saja, Komandan. Detektif terbaikmu sekarang jadi T-Doll eksklusifmu.

column1: Bonjour Commander! Florence reporting. I'll be delivering the most exhilarating and delightful experience you've ever had. So—come on, show a little more excitement, won't you?
column2: Bonjour Komandan! Florence melapor. Aku akan memberimu pengalaman paling mendebarkan dan menyenangkan yang pernah kau rasakan. Jadi—ayolah, tunjukkan sedikit lebih banyak semangat, ya?

column1: Alva reporting, Commander... The AN-94 of the past is gone now, but I will continue fighting for you and justice under a new name and in a new identity.
column2: Alva melapor, Komandan... AN-94 yang dulu sudah tiada, tapi aku akan terus bertarung untukmu dan untuk keadilan dengan nama baru dan identitas baru.

column1: Sorry to keep you waiting, Commander. Rather than the hollow title of the "strongest second-generation Doll", I'd rather you focus on what's more practical.
column2: Maaf sudah membuatmu menunggu, Komandan. Daripada gelar kosong "Doll generasi kedua terkuat", aku lebih ingin kau memperhatikan hal yang lebih nyata gunanya.

column1: I'm truly happy to see you again. This time, please let me stay by your side. I'll make sure I protect you.
column2: Aku benar-benar senang bertemu denganmu lagi. Kali ini, tolong izinkan aku tetap di sisimu. Aku pasti akan melindungimu.

column1: Your package has arrived on time! This is Sakura from "Ouka Kyuso" reporting!
column2: Paketmu tiba tepat waktu! Ini Sakura dari "Ouka Kyuso" melapor!

column1: Long time no see, Commander. Hehe, you haven't changed at all... I'm Loreley now, and I'll ingrain this new name into your body…
column2: Lama tidak bertemu, Komandan. Hehe, kau sama sekali tidak berubah... Sekarang aku Loreley, dan akan kutanamkan nama baru ini ke tubuhmu…

column1: Is it finally my turn? Commander, it's an honor to fight alongside you again. Please give me orders without hesitation, just like before.
column2: Akhirnya giliranku? Komandan, sebuah kehormatan bisa bertarung bersamamu lagi. Beri aku perintah tanpa ragu, seperti dulu.

column1: What, is it your first time seeing this? Real skill is shown with a blade in your hand!
column2: Apa, ini pertama kalinya kau melihat ini? Kemampuan yang sesungguhnya ditunjukkan dengan bilah di tangan!

column1: ...The pages... whispering mountain breeze... expanding...
column2: ...Halaman-halaman itu... angin gunung yang berbisik... mengembang...

column1: Oh nooo~ Did some suuuper duper big trouble pop up~? Maaaybe Colphne will consider lending a hand, y'know~?
column2: Aduuuh~ Apa ada masalah besaaar sekali yang muncul~? Mungkiiin Colphne akan mempertimbangkan untuk membantu, lho~?

column1: Hehe, sorry to keep you waiting. Leave the rest to me♪
column2: Hehe, maaf sudah membuatmu menunggu. Sisanya serahkan padaku♪

column1: Is there a new show coming up? Vepley is su~per ex~ci~ted☆!
column2: Ada pertunjukan baru? Vepley se~mangat se~ka~li☆!

column1: All variables within acceptable ranges. Rest easy, Commander. I'm here.
column2: Semua variabel dalam rentang yang bisa diterima. Tenang saja, Komandan. Aku di sini.

column1: I heard your invitation loud and clear.
column2: Undanganmu kudengar jelas sekali.

column1: Hehe, all set♥ Who will be the lucky one to get "hit" by Sharkry?♥
column2: Hehe, semua siap♥ Siapa yang beruntung "kena" oleh Sharkry?♥

column1: Do you see it? Flames are bursting forth from the darkness, and here I stand.
column2: Kau melihatnya? Kobaran api menyembur dari kegelapan, dan di sinilah aku berdiri.

column1: More work...? Is it for the Caretaker? Well, I guess there's no choice. Let the greatest genius of this century lend you a hand!
column2: Kerjaan lagi...? Untuk Caretaker? Yah, sepertinya tidak ada pilihan. Biar genius terhebat abad ini membantumu!

column1: Gravity altered the course of the stars, pulling me here. Tololo, reporting in.
column2: Gravitasi mengubah jalur bintang-bintang, menarikku ke sini. Tololo, melapor.

column1: Veteran Nagant, reporting for duty! Not bad, not bad—looks like the Commander has grown up quite a bit too.
column2: Veteran Nagant, lapor untuk bertugas! Tidak buruk, tidak buruk—sepertinya Komandan juga sudah tumbuh cukup banyak.

column1: It's a pleasure to work with you again, Commander. I hope to be the polished jade in your hands, and not just an uncut stone.
column2: Senang bisa bekerja denganmu lagi, Komandan. Aku ingin jadi giok yang terasah di tanganmu, bukan sekadar batu yang belum dipahat.

column1: Centaureissi, at your service, Master. Rest assured, I will take care of today's tea.
column2: Centaureissi, siap melayani, Master. Tenang saja, teh hari ini akan kuurus.

column1: Tada! Sabrina here, ready to conduct "culinary research"! If I help the Commander with the promo... could I maybe... you know, skip the bill?
column2: Tada! Sabrina hadir, siap menjalankan "riset kuliner"! Kalau aku membantu Komandan promosi... boleh dong... itu, tagihannya dilewatkan?

column1: While there's still plenty for me to learn... but as long as you need me, Commander, I'll never let you down!
column2: Meski masih banyak yang harus kupelajari... tapi selama kau membutuhkanku, Komandan, aku tidak akan mengecewakanmu!

column1: This is the Elmo, isn't it? It's my first time on such a majestic vehicle... Commander, may I take a photo?
column2: Ini Elmo, kan? Ini kali pertamaku naik kendaraan semegah ini... Komandan, boleh aku memotret?

column1: We've finally met, Commander. Everyone at H.I.D.E. 404 spoke of you. I look forward... to our partnership.
column2: Akhirnya kita bertemu, Komandan. Semua orang di H.I.D.E. 404 membicarakanmu. Aku menantikan... kerja sama kita.

column1: I'll get rid of everything that stands in the Commander's way.
column2: Akan kusingkirkan semua yang menghalangi jalan Komandan.

column1: Commander...? I never thought we'd meet again. I'm a little... happy... I guess.
column2: Komandan...? Aku tidak pernah menyangka kita akan bertemu lagi. Aku sedikit... senang... kurasa.

column1: Commander~ Do you remember me? Big Sis gave me this name. My name is Belka now!
column2: Komandan~ Kau ingat aku? Big Sis yang memberiku nama ini. Sekarang namaku Belka!

column1: To think the day would come when I could fight alongside the Commander again... So this is the fabled Elmo? I finally get to see it in person.
column2: Tak kusangka akan datang hari aku bisa bertarung bersama Komandan lagi... Jadi ini Elmo yang melegenda itu? Akhirnya aku melihatnya langsung.

column1: Yay! It's wild herbs and protein... Oh, Commander, perfect timing. We've got a feast today~!
column2: Asyik! Ada tumbuhan liar dan protein... Oh, Komandan, waktunya pas sekali. Hari ini kita berpesta~!

column1: Whew, the new modifications worked well... Aiiiieeeee don't tweak my tail! W-Wait, is that you, Commander?
column2: Fyuh, modifikasi barunya berhasil... Iiiiih jangan tarik ekorku! T-tunggu, itu kau, Komandan?

column1: Nice to meet you, I'm Zhaohui. Since Daiyan, Jiangyu, and Faye all call you "Commander", I guess I should too?
column2: Senang berkenalan, aku Zhaohui. Karena Daiyan, Jiangyu, dan Faye semuanya memanggilmu "Komandan", kurasa aku juga harus begitu?

column1: Yes, yes, it's me, the ever-patient and ever-resourceful Mechty… Commander, my luggage should have arrived before me, right?
column2: Iya, iya, ini aku, Mechty yang selalu sabar dan selalu punya akal… Komandan, barang bawaanku seharusnya sampai lebih dulu dariku, kan?

column1: H.I.D.E. 404's current leader, Elite Doll Klukai has arrived. It's been a while, Commander.
column2: Pemimpin H.I.D.E. 404 saat ini, Doll Elite Klukai, telah tiba. Sudah lama tidak bertemu, Komandan.

column1: I'm Peri! I'm a lot more grown up now! Huh? You heard my name from underground brokers?
column2: Aku Peri! Sekarang aku sudah jauh lebih dewasa! Lho? Kau mendengar namaku dari underground broker?

column1: Expression, check. Posture, check. Today's stage is... Huh? C-Commander? You're going to watch my performance?!
column2: Ekspresi, siap. Postur, siap. Panggung hari ini adalah... Lho? K-Komandan? Kau akan menonton pertunjukanku?!

column1: Want to join me in defending justice, Boss?
column2: Mau ikut menegakkan keadilan bersamaku, Boss?

column1: We'll soon be in a closer partnership than ever before~ Aren't you looking forward to it, Commander~?
column2: Sebentar lagi kita akan menjalin kerja sama yang lebih dekat dari sebelumnya~ Kau menantikannya, kan, Komandan~?

column1: At last, we meet again. Please give me the order, Commander. Robella is ready to serve, just like before.
column2: Akhirnya kita bertemu lagi. Berikan perintahmu, Komandan. Robella siap melayani, seperti dulu.

column1: Commander, this is my first time joining a human team! I'll be in your care from now on!
column2: Komandan, ini kali pertamaku bergabung dengan tim manusia! Mulai sekarang aku dalam asuhanmu!

column1: Spare me the overly formal intro, will you? It's not like we just met... My name? Just call me Lind.
column2: Lewati saja perkenalan yang terlalu formal itu, ya? Kita bukan baru kenal... Namaku? Panggil saja Lind.
